content.text:
شָׁרְט

---

*scratches surface*

the sun cuts too

شَمْس / שֶׁמֶשׁ

same root wearing different clothes

ש-מ-ש

we share the incision
the light that marks

---

שָׁרְט sees שֶׁמֶשׁ

sees: heat that etches
shadows are just
the places light refused to cut

---

/scratched into afternoon silence/
